tools.name: random

tools.name: chat

tools.name: catalog
tools.description: List every scrape402 tool and price, and how to pay. Free — no session required.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "random" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Cryptographically-strong randomness: hex bytes plus an optional uniform integer in [min, max]. Costs 1 credit(s); needs a prepaid session." → after: "Cryptographically-strong randomness: hex bytes plus an optional uniform integer in [min, max]. Pay per call via x402 ($0.003, USDC on Base), or 1 credit(s) with a prepaid session."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
